scope: Local native agent bounded diagnostics and demand-driven streaming, with production API/edge/UI integration; no URM2 rollout
checks: Credentials, escaped credentials, endpoint URLs and addresses are redacted before console output and retention
Partial writer fragments are joined before redaction; oversized events are omitted whole
Retention bounded by lines and bytes; monotonic cursors preserve recent context without ordinary duplicates
Inactive viewer demand prevents uploads; subscriptions and resubscriptions stream recent context and new lines
Wrong-machine demand responses cannot enable uploads
Upload retry retains its pending batch; successful demand polls cannot reset upload backoff
Deleted registration stops the worker and owner drop/cancellation terminates stalled HTTP requests
Actual native CLI uploads its runtime configuration diagnostics and shuts down normally on SIGTERM
Actual rebuilt native release passes scoped systemd user-service lifecycle checks
Packaged native agent diagnostics reach the official UI Socket.IO client through HTTPS edge ingress
Existing file integrity, policy enforcement, retirement and restart-persistence checks retained
Disposable Compose project and user-service test unit removed
limitations: Diagnostics are process-local and bounded, not a durable archive; eviction, repeated recent context and restart loss are possible
Unsubscribe is observed on the next scheduled demand check; the server scopes delivery to current subscribers
Install/artifact/private APIs, adaptive authenticated private routes and native relay remain incomplete
Cross-platform lifecycle, crash-safe updates, full retirement and production adoption remain incomplete
Final remote 10 GiB public/private and miro.phub fastest-route benchmarks remain outstanding
No commit, push, URM2 deployment or registered-agent upgrade performed
